news.headline: Tulane wins the Battle for the Bell 24-21
news.summary: Maurice Turner ran for 200 yards Saturday at Yulman Stadium, and his 74-yard touchdown run with 5:26 left put Tulane ahead. TJ Smith then blocked a Southern Miss field goal to save the win for coach Will Hall against his old team.

news.headline: Jamauri McClure misses another game
news.summary: Tulane's running back will sit out Saturday's game against Southern Miss with a foot injury, and he has not played at all this season. The Green Wave have a bye next week and hope he can come back October 10 at Army.

news.headline: Cooper Helmke sets the Tulane field goal record
news.summary: Helmke's 58-yard kick at Kansas State on Saturday is the longest in school history, one yard past the mark Cairo Santos set in 2012. The redshirt freshman missed all of last season with a back injury and a hip injury.

news.headline: Florida jumps to No. 8 in the new rankings
news.summary: The Gators moved up 13 spots in the Associated Press poll after beating Ole Miss 52-28 on Saturday. It is the first time Florida has been in the top 10 in five years.

news.headline: Florida runs over Ole Miss 52-28
news.summary: Jadan Baugh ran for 142 yards and three touchdowns Saturday afternoon in Gainesville as Florida beat the fourth-ranked Rebels. The Gators are 4-0 for the first time since 2019.

news.headline: Eric Singleton plays again and catches a long pass
news.summary: Singleton had not played since he hurt his ankle in the first game of the year. He caught one pass for 38 yards against Ole Miss, the longest catch Florida had all day.

news.headline: Texas stays No. 1 in the new rankings
news.summary: The Longhorns kept the top spot in the Associated Press poll after winning 20-17 at Tennessee. They are 4-0 and play Oklahoma in Dallas on October 10.

news.headline: Texas holds off Tennessee 20-17
news.summary: Raleek Brown ran for two touchdowns Saturday in Knoxville, and his 4-yard run with 5:41 left was the one that won it. Colin Simmons had five sacks to tie the Texas record, and the Longhorns are 4-0.

news.headline: Colin Simmons is cleared to play at Tennessee
news.summary: Colin Simmons hurt his foot last week against UTSA, but he is off the injury list and can play Saturday. Tight end Nick Townsend is out and running back Hollywood Smothers is still questionable.

news.headline: Seven Saints are out against the Raiders
news.summary: Receiver Barion Brown, cornerback Martin Emerson Jr. and five other players are inactive for Sunday's game in the Superdome. Las Vegas tight end Brock Bowers is playing for the first time this season.

news.headline: Saints add two receivers for Sunday
news.summary: The Saints moved receivers Kevin Austin Jr. and Jalen Moreno-Cropper up from the practice squad Saturday so they can play against the Raiders. Barion Brown, one of the team's receivers, is out with an injury.

news.headline: Two Saints are out for Sunday's home game
news.summary: Receiver Barion Brown and lineman Christen Miller will not play against the Raiders. Cornerback Martin Emerson practiced for the first time this week and is listed as a maybe.

news.headline: IUP wins a five-set thriller at Clarion
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-19, 19-25, 23-25, 25-22, 15-9 on Saturday afternoon for their tenth win in a row. Delaney Concannon had 17 kills and 18 digs, and IUP is 11-3 and unbeaten in the conference.

news.headline: IUP wins its ninth match in a row
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks beat Slippery Rock 3-1 on Friday night and have not lost since August 29. Charlotte Potvin had 14 kills without a single miss, and IUP is now 10-3.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

news.headline: Rain calls off the last game of the season
news.summary: Sunday's game with Baltimore was called off and will not be made up. The Yankees finish the regular season 93-68 and start the playoffs Tuesday.

news.headline: Cam Schlittler will pitch Game 1 against Boston
news.summary: He starts Tuesday night's playoff opener at Yankee Stadium. Max Fried pitches Game 2, and Gerrit Cole would pitch Game 3 if the series goes that far.

news.headline: Clarke Schmidt goes on the injured list
news.summary: The Yankees put the pitcher on the injured list Friday with a nerve problem in his right arm, so he will not pitch in the playoff series against Boston. Manager Aaron Boone said Schmidt should be able to train normally over the winter.

news.headline: Warren Easton loses at Zachary
news.summary: Zachary won 49-28 on Friday night. Warren Easton is 0-4 and plays at Riverdale on Thursday, October 1.

news.headline: Warren Easton falls to Brother Martin
news.summary: Brother Martin scored early and often Friday night and won 56-6. Warren Easton is 0-3 and plays at Zachary next Friday.
